groups.why: Checks whether LookupCommon (OPERATION_GROUP) candidates are current when divisionId is ''. That differs from the divisionId '40' row, so it stays alone.
Checks LookupCommon candidates with divisionId '40'. Its condition value differs from the divisionId '' row, so it stays alone.
Checks PlantSiteByDivision with divisionId '' only. EG-224cda47 sends extra parameters, so the request body is not the same and the row stays alone.
Checks PlantSiteByDivision with divisionId '' plus lookupType and other parameters. The request differs from the minimal-parameter row, so it stays alone.
Checks PlantSiteByDivision with divisionId '40' only. It is not grouped with the '40' request that sends extra parameters.
Checks PlantSiteByDivision with divisionId '40' plus lookupType and other parameters. The request body differs, so it stays alone.
Checks YesOrNo with no parameters. It is not certain that the extra parameters in the other YesOrNo requests are ignored, so this row stays alone.
Checks YesOrNo with divisionId '' and the OPERATION_GROUP parameters. The request body differs, so it stays alone.
Checks YesOrNo with divisionId '40' and the OPERATION_GROUP parameters. The request body differs, so it stays alone.
This is the only row that checks the SCM0001_GET_DIVISION combo.
This is the only row that checks the MyDivision combo.
Checks in the UI that the Div search condition reflects master changes. That is a different element and method from the DB re-run rows.
Checks in the UI that the Operation group search condition reflects changes. That method differs from the LookupCommon DB re-run rows.
Checks the From Site multi-select search condition. No other row checks this element.
Checks the Active search condition. No other row checks this element.
Checks the team name shown in the Team (DEPT_ID) cell combo after DEPT_ID is changed in SSPM. Its expected result is different from V-30b82a62, so it stays alone.
Checks that the Team change from SSPM appears on re-query, under the separate condition Div=82. Its condition and expected result differ, so it stays alone.
Checks that newly registered LOOKUP entries appear in the grid's End Customer and Sold to Customer combos. The grid cell combo is a different element from the search-condition combos.
Checks that the Team search condition is refreshed right after a new team is saved and still includes it on reopen. Both the element and the expected result are specific to this row.
Checks that one save succeeds and the new master item, such as a Sales Site, appears in the search-condition combo. The target element and expected result differ from the other rows.
